title: 16S rRNA gene sequencing of MBBR carrier biofilm treating biodiesel wastewater
description: This BioProject contains bacterial 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data from a moving bed biofilm reactor (MBBR) carrier biofilm sample collected during the biological treatment of high-strength biodiesel wastewater. The sequencing data were generated to characterize the microbial community associated with biofilm formation and organic matter removal in the MBBR system. The data support a study evaluating the performance of MBBR treatment for biodiesel wastewater and its effect on subsequent coagulation treatment.
samples: MIMARKS Survey related sample from wastewater metagenome
